notes.title: Class of Heroes 3 Remaster is OUT NOW!
notes.notes: [h2]Class of Heroes 3 Remaster is OUT NOW![/h2][p][/p][p]Class of Heroes 3 Remaster features not one... but THREE schools for you to enroll in. As a student the choice is yours, will you join Drakken Academy, Preciana Institute or Takachino College? Each school  offers a different starting point with its own quests! So pick wisely! [/p][p][/p][p]Just like in the previous two releases, you’ll set out on quests and delve into a wide variety of 3D dungeons, battling monsters, leveling up, and gathering loot along the way. But this remaster doesn’t just revisit the adventure,  it [b]e[/b]xpands and improves the experience with exciting new features:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Increase in the number of items and weapons to discover and use.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]45 different classes across 10 different races allowing endless party building possibilities.[/p][/*][*][p]A character relationship system[/p][/*][*][p]Quality of life upgrades that make the experience more convenient to play[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][previewyoutube="Hhtt63mbgbE;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Don’t miss out! Play today![/p]

notes.title: Class of Heroes 3 Remaster is coming 18th September 2025!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Class of Heroes 3 Remaster is coming 18th September 2025![/b][/p][p][/p][p]The wait is almost over, not long now until you can embark on the long-anticipated return of Class of Heroes![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="kzICEVJisBU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]In [b]Class of Heroes 3 Remaster[/b], you’ll step into the shoes of a student enrolling into an academy. Choose from three unique academies, each offering access to a wide variety of classes, spread across multiple races.[/p][p]Prepare to dive into challenging quests, sprawling dungeons, and tactical battles against fearsome monsters. Every step forward demands caution and preparation. Don’t underestimate your enemies, you may not live to regret it![/p][p]Strategic party-building is your key to survival. Level up your students, gather powerful loot, and refine your team along the way. Whether you choose to adventure with the default party or create custom students from scratch, you’ll assign skill points based on race and class, tailoring your strategy to suit your playstyle.[/p][p]Class of Heroes 3 Remaster also introduces a host of new features and enhancements, including a greater item and weapon count to help you push deeper into danger.[/p][p]And for the first time, you’ll be able to build a character relationship chart, choose who your party members like or dislike, and unlock unique abilities and skill sets based on those bonds. Use their relationships to your tactical advantage![/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Class of Heroes 3 Remaster Is Coming Soon
notes.notes:
After 15 years, the wait is over!

Class of Heroes 3 Remaster is finally making its way to the West, delivering the most expansive and feature-packed adventure in the series yet!

This classic school-based, 3D dungeon-crawling RPG is back with even more features, a larger roster of characters, an array of exciting new classes, and even bigger, more challenging dungeons.

Mark your calendars and get ready to sharpen your wits - classes are officially back in session!
